fixture.capture: Matched fixed-view growth, flyby, morning pan and gap closure sequences
fixture.timing: Production cloud tracing and reconstruction pass timestamps, reported individually and as a paired per-frame sum in milliseconds. Configured step limits and three independently replayed native-pixel step counts are recorded separately. Resident VRAM is unmeasured.
fixture.visualReview: Review ordered frames for shape, lighting, silver lining, flicker, ghosts, banding, polar seams and continuous cross-scale transitions. Pixel changes alone cannot establish visual acceptance.
